tailoring.headline: Techno-Functional Lead Developer | SAP Commerce Cloud & E-Commerce Architecture | AI-Assisted Delivery
tailoring.summary: SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of experience leading technical delivery for enterprise e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring Boot, and RESTful API architecture, with a proven track record in techno-functional consulting, stakeholder management, and AI-assisted development. Skilled in designing scalable data flows between PIM, ERP, and MDM systems. Adept at guiding international teams through complex integrations, production troubleshooting, and agile delivery to ensure high-performance, business-aligned digital products.

cover_en.subject: Application: Lead Frontend / Fullstack Engineer
cover_en.hook: Protofy’s focus on translating technology into measurable business outcomes aligns perfectly with my experience as a techno-functional lead. With over 5 years of experience delivering enterprise e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I specialize in bridging the gap between complex technical architecture and business requirements.

bullets.label: Technical Leadership
bullets.text: I have led technical delivery for large-scale e-commerce projects, managing architecture, API design, and integration strategies while mentoring junior developers.

bullets.label: Stakeholder Consulting
bullets.text: In my role at Rockwell Automation, I acted as the primary technical partner for international business stakeholders, translating complex requirements into functional specifications and solution designs.

bullets.label: AI-Driven Development
bullets.text: I extensively utilize generative AI and LLM tools to accelerate development cycles, documentation, and quality assurance, directly supporting the professional standards Protofy maintains.

bullets.label: Full-Lifecycle Delivery
bullets.text: I have managed the end-to-end lifecycle of enterprise applications, from initial requirements analysis and architecture design to CI/CD deployment and production support.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe and hold a valid German residence and work permit. I am currently serving a notice period and will be available to start on 16 December 2026.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung: Lead Frontend / Fullstack Engineer
cover_de.hook: Protofy’s Ansatz, Technologie als messbaren Business Case zu begreifen, entspricht genau meiner Arbeitsweise als technischer Lead. Mit über 5 Jahren Erfahrung in der Entwicklung komplexer E-Commerce-Plattformen bei Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich fundierte Expertise in der Architekturberatung und der Leitung technischer Teams mit.

bullets.label: Technische Führung
bullets.text: Ich habe die technische Verantwortung für komplexe E-Commerce-Projekte übernommen, von der Architekturplanung bis hin zur erfolgreichen Implementierung und dem Deployment.

bullets.label: Stakeholder-Management
bullets.text: Als technischer Ansprechpartner für internationale Stakeholder übersetze ich komplexe Geschäftsanforderungen in präzise funktionale Spezifikationen und skalierbare Lösungen.

bullets.label: KI-gestützte Entwicklung
bullets.text: Ich setze generative KI-Tools gezielt ein, um Entwicklungsprozesse zu beschleunigen, die Dokumentation zu optimieren und die Qualitätssicherung effizient zu gestalten.

bullets.label: Ganzheitliche Projektverantwortung
bullets.text: Ich begleite Projekte ganzheitlich, unterstütze bei der Aufwandsschätzung und stelle sicher, dass technische Entscheidungen stets wirtschaftlich und pragmatisch getroffen werden.

cover_de.logistics: Ich lebe in Karlsruhe und verfüge über eine unbefristete Arbeitserlaubnis. Aufgrund meiner Kündigungsfrist stehe ich ab dem 16. Dezember 2026 zur Verfügung.

tailoring.why_company: Protofy stands out for its pragmatic, outcome-oriented approach to digital products. I am drawn to your focus on translating technology into measurable business value, which mirrors my own techno-functional background. I am eager to contribute my experience in enterprise architecture and AI-assisted development to your team, helping to drive efficiency and growth for your clients while continuing to shape professional standards in a collaborative, high-impact environment.
tailoring.motivation_short: I am motivated by the opportunity to lead complex, high-impact projects at Protofy, combining my deep technical background in e-commerce architecture with my passion for AI-driven development and strategic stakeholder consulting.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi Team, I am a Lead Developer with 5+ years of experience in enterprise e-commerce and techno-functional consulting. I admire Protofy's outcome-oriented approach and would love to contribute to your team. My CV and cover letter are attached. Best, Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Lead Frontend / Fullstack Engineer - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Lead Frontend / Fullstack Engineer position at Protofy. With over 5 years of experience in enterprise e-commerce architecture, techno-functional consulting, and AI-assisted development, I am confident in my ability to lead your technical projects and deliver measurable business value. I am based in Germany and available to start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how my background aligns with your team's needs.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
